title: Watch: Delhi-NCR drowns in rain chaos; 7 videos show waterlogging, gridlock
content: heavy rainfall lashed several parts of Delhi and the National Capital Region (NCR) on Friday, leading to widespread waterlogging, traffic congestion and disruptions to vehicular movement . the IMD issued a red alert, forecasting moderate rain at many places and heavy rain at isolated locations .

title: US appeals court halts Trump's $400 million ballroom project
content: a US federal appeals court on Friday ordered president Donald Trump's administration to halt construction of a proposed $400 million ballroom at the white house . in a 2-1 ruling, the US Court of Appeals for the district of Columbia upheld a preliminary injunction obtained by the National Trust for Historic Preservation . the court put its order on hold for 14 days, giving the administration time to appeal to the US Supreme Court .

title: The political cost of Europe’s migration dilemma
content: anti-immigration sentiment has grown why is Europe becoming increasingly resistant to immigration? images of thousands of people swimming desperately, scrambling over rocks or wading through the sea have thrust Europe into the global spotlight . this is the latest chapter in Europe's long struggle to balance humanitarian obligations with domestic political realities .
